LanguageData.MST.statOffsetsComment: Stat value offsets applied by this gene.
LanguageData.MST.statFactorsComment: Stat value multipliers applied by this gene.
LanguageData.MST.capModsComment: Pawn capacity modifiers (offset, setMax, postFactor) applied by this gene.
LanguageData.MST.damageFactorsComment: Damage type multipliers applied by this gene.
LanguageData.MST.forcedTraitsComment: Traits forced by this gene (with optional degree).
LanguageData.MST.suppressedTraitsComment: Traits suppressed by this gene (with optional degree).
LanguageData.MST.aptitudesComment: Skill aptitudes (skill level bonuses) granted by this gene.
LanguageData.MST.passionModSkillComment: Skill affected by this gene's passion modifier.
LanguageData.MST.passionModTypeComment: Type of passion modification: AddOneLevel adds one passion level, DropAll removes all passion.
LanguageData.MST.disabledWorkTagsComment: Work types disabled by this gene.
LanguageData.MST.makeImmuneToComment: Hediffs this gene makes the pawn immune to.
LanguageData.MST.hediffGiversCannotGiveComment: HediffGivers that this gene prevents from giving hediffs.
